title: The tunnel's exit
goals: Reach the mark, by the first statue.
Do not let Dask see you.
starting_code:
# Wait two ticks with `wait`, for Dask to go by.

# Walk right to the mark with `move_right`.
hints: Dask is coming up the corridor that crosses this one. If we cross now, he sees us.
Count the ticks: let him go by, and only then walk.
After waiting, it is nine steps to the right.
intro: Dask is coming up the corridor that crosses this one, looking up. If we cross now he will see us: let us wait for him to go by and walk to the first statue.
outro: He went by without seeing us! And now he is up ahead, by the statues...
learned: Now you know that `wizard.wait()` lets a tick go by while everything else moves, and that the number says how many.
